dish: Soki soba (stewed pork spare-rib soba — the shop's own invention)
n: Gabusoka Shokudo Honten (我部祖河食堂 本店)
w: Founded in 1966 and billed as the birthplace of soki soba: the founder, then a butcher, simmered unsold spare ribs for hours and laid them on soba. House-made wavy noodles, punchy pork-bone broth.

dish: Soki soba (bonito-and-pork broth, stewed spare rib)
address: 70-1 Izumi, Motobu, Kunigami District, Okinawa, Japan
w: The queue-before-opening star of the Motobu 'soba road' (Route 84): a mellow bonito-and-pork broth unchanged for four decades, soki or three-layer pork on top; closes when the noodles run out.

dish: Tacos (crisp-shell, the Okinawan base-town style) and taco rice
n: Mexico, Chatan (タコス専門店 メキシコ)
w: Taco-only shop serving since 1977 — one of the island's most famous taco joints, crisp shells stuffed with seasoned beef in the style US servicemen brought to Okinawa.

dish: Awamori (aged kusu) tasting — Zuisen / Omoro labels
w: Shuri awamori maker descended from the distillers who supplied the royal court; free tour of the stills and fermentation tanks, a look into the kusu ageing cellar and a tasting of Zuisen and Omoro.
